description: Set take-profit and/or stop-loss trigger prices on a position, optionally closing only part of it at each (percent 1-100). Pass the version from get_position_protection; a stale version is refused so app changes are never overwritten.

stop_loss_percent.description: Percent of the position the stop-loss closes (default 100).

stop_loss_price.description: Trigger price on the loss side.

take_profit_percent.description: Percent of the position the take-profit closes (default 100).

take_profit_price.description: Trigger price on the profit side.

version.description: version from get_position_protection (0 when none is set).

name: set_position_protection
